voice_notes.transcript: okay saint john day one. des hawks from fundy shore physio, four clinics, saint john rothesay quispamsis and grand bay. they're on clinic vo and his big gripe is it can't run one wait list across the four, so a cancellation in rothesay never gets offered to somebody waiting in grand bay. wants a demo and he wants his clinic managers on it. really good one.

gerald thorn, portland street physio, three sites, east side west side and grand bay, everything on spreadsheets. wants pricing for the three. and he asked if we can put the work safe NB claim number right on the booking, they've got a lot of work safe clients. I said I'd find out, I honestly don't know if we do that.

leanne quinlin, kingshurst massage, uptown. three RMTs on one google calendar and they keep double booking the big room. she wants the price for three. and she was really clear, no newsletters, she unsubscribes from everything, just send her the number and that's it. so pricing only, nothing else.

shavonne core me ay I think, physio in riverview, just her clinic, on practice shift. her clients can't cancel online, they have to phone and leave a message and half the time nobody gets it. nice chat, didn't ask for anything.

kristen vow tour, quispamsis physio and sport, three clinics, quispamsis rothesay and hampton, all on a paper book still. she wants people to be able to book at night online because the phones only get answered nine to five. she's expecting in june, going off on mat leave and her sister's covering, so she's not shopping right now. don't bring the baby up obviously.

hammond river physio, two clinics, quispamsis and hampton. the manager brianna wants a trial for her two front desk people before anybody else touches it. the owner martin was with her, separate guy, he asked about intake forms people fill in on their phone before they come in, send him something on that. they're on google calendar. so two people, trial for brianna, info for martin.

mac oh gilvy, tantra mar physio group, sackville amherst moncton and dieppe so four. they're on books dead and books dead put the price per practitioner up in january and he's still steaming about it. he wants a demo and wants the owner on it, he's ops not the owner. got his card.

lloyd from miramichi, drove down this morning in the snow, his daughter's in nursing at UNB saint john and we mostly talked about her. massage, just him, paper book. nothing to send really, lovely guy.

paulette dwar on, doiron maybe, massage in dieppe and moncton, two spots, on pract shift. her RMTs can't see each other's schedules on their phones so they text each other all day. didn't ask for anything.
kaylee at the front desk at simons street physio, uptown. paper book. she wants something she can show her boss, she's not the one who decides. one clinic.

nadia had a long one in french this morning, josie seer, from edmundston, physio, two clinics, the other one's in grand falls, on pract shift. she wants a written quote, in french, price per therapist. nadia has her card and says she'll do that one herself.
scanner battery's been dead since about half past one and the charger's in the car, so this afternoon's cards are in my jacket pocket. I'll give them to erin. long day.
